description: Best practices for robust, performant, maintainable cross-platform mobile apps with Expo.

Structure: `assets/` static assets; `src/` app logic; `src/components/` reusable UI; `src/screens/` distinct views; `src/navigation/` (if not using Expo Router `app/`); `src/hooks/`; `src/utils/`; `src/services/`.

Naming: dirs `kebab-case`; components `PascalCase`; variables/functions `camelCase`; constants `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`.

Functional+TS+styles: **Functional Components with Hooks:** Always use functional components. class MyComponent extends React.Component { /* ... */ } ; const MyComponent: React.FC = () => { /* ... */ }; **TypeScript for Type Safety:** All new code must be in TypeScript. function greet(name) {
